d:
Jan Suraaj ke navnirvachit MLC SP Rai ne bihar vidhan parishad men sadasyata ki shapath li.
Shapath grahan samaroh ke dauran Prashant Kishor bhi maujud rahe, janie unhonne is mauke par kya kaha.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
